purpose: Fix unintentional halving of nominal IMU pose reporting; no claim of static jitter or ground-truth accuracy improvement.

change.default: Negative min-report-time follows nominal IMU cadence with 1% period tolerance, without overwriting the attached setting.
change.explicit: Nonnegative min-report-time retains its requested interval, quantized to the nearest sensor tick; no default clock tolerance.
change.clock: Compare integer sensor tick differences, suppress non-increasing timestamps, keep a report limit for intervening optical updates. Report-variance statistics also use tick differences.

validation.negative_control: Frozen old library emits 500 of 1000 3.989333-ms samples; new library emits all 1000. Tests also cover 4.000/4.005333 ms, 32-bit wrap, day/large epochs, explicit limits, optical interleaving, faster-than-nominal events and sub-ULP tick deltas.

static_protocol.position: Linear interpolation at the IMU origin; 3D RMS about the time mean.
static_protocol.orientation: Normalized, sign-aligned quaternion interpolation; rotation vector about midpoint reference, RMS about its mean.
static_protocol.velocity: Nearest receive-clock velocity; alignment spreads retained in the analysis.
static_protocol.fixed_prediction: 0/10/50/100 ms diagnostic extrapolations, not actual Monado prediction horizon.
static_protocol.limitation: Fresh serial replay does not reproduce the original live filter/calibration trajectory: approximately 2.98 mm position RMS versus original live sub-mm stability. Only baseline/candidate replay comparison isolates the reporting change. Static replay alone does not measure movement or end-to-end latency.
